card.title: The Rule You Broke
card.instruction: Treat a past breach of rule or custom as unfinished business. Let every present exception reopen the question of what was damaged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're letting guests use the good mugs now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only because the other mugs are packed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I used one, you called it a breach of trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I replaced the mug. Will you tell them that when you do your usual warning about letting me carry things?

mechanism: A treats a present mug exception as reopening an old breach-of-trust judgment and demands acknowledgment that the material damage was repaired.
confusable: Unlike simple objection to inconsistent rules, A focuses on what the earlier breach continues to do to A's reputation.
comparison: The mugs alternative challenges a repeated personal warning; the duty alternative seeks correction at the original complaint record.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
